properties.description: CR-0: Concrete Step/Learn semantics and safety
properties.name: CR-0: Concrete Step/Learn semantics and safety
properties.remaining: Provide complete trace semantics and a nontrivial permitted witness preserving schema, owner, references, invariants and lineage.

properties.name: CR-1: Constructive outcome-conditioned improvement
properties.remaining: Derive probability and fresh evaluation from actual sampling, continuous update and a strong independently learned comparator.

properties.name: CR-2: Derived causal identification
properties.remaining: Bind randomized assignment, consistency, interference scope, uncertainty and independent outcome custody to an actual prospective protocol.

properties.description: CR-3: Causal multiscale credit without double counting
properties.name: CR-3: Causal multiscale credit without double counting
properties.remaining: Define and validate nonduplicating counterfactual attribution against shuffled, uniform and global-only credit controls.

properties.description: CR-4: Useful coalition and topology construction/recovery
properties.name: CR-4: Useful coalition and topology construction/recovery
properties.remaining: Construct bounded n-ary coalition/topology dynamics, prove resource and recovery properties, and test against fixed controls.

properties.description: CR-5: Joint world/self prediction and diachronic continuity
properties.name: CR-5: Joint world/self prediction and diachronic continuity
properties.remaining: Specify prediction, migration, member-change and lineage interventions; distinguish preservation from world-only, registry-only and snapshot-copy alternatives.

properties.description: CR-6: Concrete composition, intervention and effect preservation
properties.name: CR-6: Concrete composition, intervention and effect preservation
properties.remaining: A stale local improvement is insufficient; construct and test an effect-preserving composition rule under noisy, delayed, n-ary interactions.

properties.description: CR-7: One simultaneous witness, runtime refinement and external validity
properties.name: CR-7: One simultaneous witness, runtime refinement and external validity
properties.remaining: One nontrivial construction must satisfy CR-0 through CR-6 together, refine the runtime trace, and be supported by new independent external observation.

properties.name: FCL-1: local causal learning
properties.remaining: Construct outcome-conditioned improvement from real sampling, identify its causal effect, and show external outcome-to-revision-to-fresh-behavior mediation.

properties.name: FCL-2: composition preservation
properties.remaining: Define a concrete typed composition with ports, conflict, rights, exit, provenance and bounded intervention/effect preservation.

properties.name: FCL-3: emergent coalition
properties.remaining: Show context-dependent n-ary coalition construction is useful beyond fixed router, roster and pairwise controls.

properties.name: FCL-4: multiscale credit
properties.remaining: Identify counterfactual credit without double counting across cell, incidence, coalition and whole-system scales.

properties.name: FCL-5: topology morphogenesis
properties.remaining: Establish outcome-bound role-incidence and interaction-order change with lesion/recovery against fixed-topology controls.

properties.name: FCL-6: world-self co-model
properties.remaining: Demonstrate joint world and self-structure prediction that conditions behavior beyond world-only and external-registry alternatives.

properties.name: FCL-7: diachronic continuity
properties.remaining: Show lineage and counterfactual dispositions survive specified model, member and schema changes beyond a label or snapshot copy.

properties.name: FCL-8: HSWM-of-HSWMs
properties.remaining: Repeat the same bounded operational contract and intervention-effective evidence at at least two scales without wrapper or central-controller substitution.
